description: Finds files on the Mac. With query: searches names and contents with Spotlight, newest first (inside path, if given). Without query: lists the folder at path (the home folder if empty), or shows a file's details. Paths may start with ~; others are taken from the home folder. Spotlight skips hidden and excluded folders; list those instead.

limit.description: When searching: at most this many files (default 30, up to 200)

machine.description: The machine to use, by name, as the machines tool lists it. Leave it out when only one machine offers this tool.

path.description: The folder to list or search in, or a file to describe

query.description: Words in the file's name or content

name: files_find
title: Find Files
